answer: Because the glacier index resolves every citation against the prism checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the kernel audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. A farm of 1225 identities would post 4052 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
